title: WorkspaceModel
description: An upstream model in a workspace's catalogue and whether the workspace routes to it. Only `active` is configurable; the rest describes the model and may change as providers and the catalogue change.

id.description: The model slug, `<provider>:<model_id>`. This is the {model} path segment.

model_id.description: The upstream model id. May contain `/` or `:`.

display_name.description: Curated name; the model id when uncatalogued.

active.description: Whether the workspace routes to this model. Opt-in: false until set.

catalogued.description: False for a model discovered at the provider but not yet in routeur.ai's curated catalogue (prices and context may then be null).

availability.description: Last provider discovery result; null if never observed. Tolerate unknown values.

input_per_1k.description: Input price per 1,000 tokens, in USD.

output_per_1k.description: Output price per 1,000 tokens, in USD.
